paragraphs: Mentioned in Shabbat, chapter 8, halakhah 1. Hyman calls this a scribal error: it should read R' Yitzchak bar Bisna, as the statement appears in Shekalim, chapter 3, halakhah 2, and chapter 8, halakhah 1.[^1]

notes.text: 8h 1/3h 2/8h 1 preserve all three source chapter/halakhah labels without fresh edition verification or added corpus; Jerusalem Talmud is suggested, not named. Hyman’s definite scribal-error/should-read assertion changes Kahana to Bisna, not a freshly established identity. Both title abbreviations remain R'.
